purpose: Bounded free/public source-redundancy qualification for the existing USYC SOURCE_RECOVERY_CANDIDATE recorded in Dataset Seal #111.
qualification_requirements: Source must be official, free/public, auditable and legally accessible without private credentials.
Exact asset identity must match the frozen V2A coin_id/symbol; ticker equality or a trading-page label alone is insufficient.
Raw response bytes must be preserved and SHA-256 hashed before normalization.
Provider, endpoint/pair, request parameters, retrieval timestamp, raw hash and parser/schema version must be recorded.
Timestamp semantics/timezone and deterministic schema mapping must be explicit.
Duplicate, missing-day, monotonic-time, OHLC and nonnegative-volume QA must pass fail-closed where the source exposes those fields.
Any source-field limitation must be surfaced explicitly and cannot be silently synthesized or substituted.
Historical coverage and asset-lifetime sufficiency must be adjudicated under the already-frozen V2A rule without changing denominator, cutoff or methodology.
Any clean Deribit candidate may only be admitted under a separate adjudication; historical qualification data cannot repair prior PIT snapshots or count as prospective evidence.
No methodology, denominator, threshold, cutoff, clocks or economics may change as part of source recovery.
Any source/API failure or insufficient history remains evidence and must not trigger silent substitution.
